Monthly summary for the solar observatory. The SSN reached its highest level of the cycle during October. Observers at three stations reported clear skies on most days. The SSN fell slightly in the last week as several active regions rotated off the visible disk. Calibration of the main telescope was completed on schedule. The station also tested a new data link to the archive, which worked without errors. Staffing was normal for the month and no equipment failed. The next summary will appear in early December, after the monthly review meeting. Visitors may request a tour by writing to the observatory office, which answers within a week. The library added two new volumes on solar physics and one on instrument design. A small exhibit about the history of the station opened in the lobby, with photographs from the first decades of observing. Heating in the dome was repaired before the cold weather began. Parking near the main entrance will be limited during the resurfacing work planned for the spring.
